name: Cafe Ritterhof
beschreibung: The Cafe Ritterhof in Ellmau is classified as a comfortable hotel and guesthouse featuring an attached café. The rooms are equipped with a private bathroom and satellite TV. The café serves authentic Tyrolean specialities and freshly baked pastries. A comprehensive breakfast buffet is served each morning. In fine weather, the sun terrace is open to guests, and the location provides quick access to regional hiking and skiing.
